aboutHeading: Lawn Care Experts in Keilor Park
aboutText: Instant Lawn & Turf Suppliers Melbourne has been providing high-quality turf and lawn care services to Keilor Park and surrounding areas for over 10 years. We specialise in drought-tolerant grass varieties like Sir Walter Buffalo and TifTuf, ensuring your lawn stays green and healthy all year round. Our team is dedicated to offering expert advice and top-notch products to meet your lawn care needs.
servicesText: We supply and install a wide range of premium turf varieties suited to Melbourne's climate. From residential lawns to commercial projects, our team ensures proper installation and care for a lush, green outcome.

services.title: Sir Walter Buffalo Turf
services.desc: Premium Sir Walter Buffalo grass, perfect for Melbourne's climate, providing a soft, lush lawn that stays green year-round.

services.title: Premium Eureka Kikuyu VG
services.desc: Eureka Kikuyu VG is a vigorous grower, ideal for large areas and sports fields, offering excellent ground coverage.

services.title: TifTuf Drought-Tolerant Turf
services.desc: TifTuf is engineered for water efficiency, maintaining a green lawn even in drought conditions with minimal irrigation.

services.title: RTF Tall Fescue Turf
services.desc: RTF Tall Fescue is a blend that provides a durable, shade-tolerant lawn suitable for various soil types.

services.title: Lawn ColourGuard Products
services.desc: ColourGuard lawn tint instantly restores green colour to dormant or drought-affected grass, lasting up to three months.

services.title: Turf Installation Services
services.desc: Our expert team ensures proper turf installation, from site preparation to laying, for a healthy, established lawn.
